title: Semidefinite relaxations for nonlinear elasticity with energies convex in the Cauchy-Green strain tensor
summary: In nonlinear elasticity, finding the deformation of a material which minimizes a given stored energy density is a challenging calculus of variations problem which may fail to have minimizers: the energy optimal material forms infinitely fine microstructures (wrinkles) rather than deforming smoothly.
